chapter: Chicago, the Woodside, the army and 52nd Street
title: Chicago, his mother's death, and the Arcadia Ballroom hostesses
summary: After his mother died he rejoined Roy in New York at the Arcadia Ballroom opposite Les Brown, where hostesses made it a glorified taxi dance.
